answer: A new key mints a non-transferable copper receipt by parking 1,850 POA, yield-free, tied to one payer. To stay in the reward oasis it must finish a fresh 35-second unique task every epoch; each idle epoch burns 90 POA off the lock, and three misses void the receipt. Leftover stake is held until dawn of the 20th epoch and released only if no shared-payer clone is found. Honest cost: 1,850 POA plus live work; 700 sybils idle 1.3 million POA as it decays, vs ~180 POA reward. Bots can fake activity, so the oasis puzzle is unrepeatable and keys that share a payer are slashed together.
